source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 22 august — «Sfântul Mucenic Irineu»

attestations.note: The page doxologia's calendar links for him carries neither a Viață tab nor a Tropar tab; the calendar line is everything the source gives. He is not identified with Irenaeus of Lyon, of Rome or of Sirmium, whom the corpus keeps on other days out of other sources.

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 22ης Αυγούστου — «Άγιοι Ειρηναίος, Ωρ και Ορόψις»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 22 Αυγούστου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. The entry names three men and the corpus already kept two of them, Irenaeus and Or, so the third — Oropsis — is a new folder and the other two are upgrades in the same batch. Irenaeus is a priest, «διέπρεπε μεταξύ των ιερέων της Εκκλησίας του Χριστού»; Or and Oropsis are laymen who remonstrated with the eparch who was watching his tortures and were tortured with him. saint.gr gives no year, no city and no name for the eparch, so there is no `dates` object and no `locations` entry. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on the life page. The page prints no hymn, only one distich for the three together.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue as printed by pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (24 September 2026).
